description: This file defines React hooks and functions for gathering and managing workspace optimization metrics and dashboard data in the Mattermost admin console, including checks for updates, configuration, access, performance, data privacy, and ease of management.

methods.name: getUpdatesData
methods.description: Fetches data related to server updates, including title, description, icon, and update check results.

methods.name: getConfigurationData
methods.description: Fetches configuration status data, including title, description, icon, and configuration check results.

methods.name: getAccessData
methods.description: Fetches workspace access data, including title, description, icon, and access check results.

methods.name: getPerformanceData
methods.description: Fetches performance-related data, including title, description, icon, and performance check results.

methods.name: getDataPrivacyData
methods.description: Fetches data privacy status data, including title, description, icon, and privacy check results.

methods.name: getEaseOfManagementData
methods.description: Fetches ease of management data, including title, description, icon, and management check results.

methods.name: useMetricsData
methods.description: React hook that manages fetching and state for all workspace optimization metrics data, returning data and loading state.
